_comment: Single source of truth for the multi-version documentation site.
Consumed by website/scripts/build-versioned-site.sh (which git refs to build, and at which URL path)
and by website/docusaurus.config.ts (the navbar version dropdown labels + hrefs), so a version is
declared once instead of being duplicated between the build and the UI.
label   - text shown in the navbar version dropdown (e.g. "next (v27)", "v26").
path    - URL path the sub-site is published under, leading and trailing slash ("/", "/v26/").
ref     - git branch or tag the sub-site is built from.
current - true for the single entry built from the checkout itself and published at the site root.
Every branch listed here builds its own sub-site from its own tree, so this file has to be kept in
sync across master and each release/v* branch that appears in it.
Deliberately not named versions.json: that filename is reserved by Docusaurus' own versioned-docs
feature, which this site does not use (each major line is a separate Docusaurus build).
